brief: Retire the roadway's surface and lay it properly. Measured at 1600x950, seed 42, day 3, 10.4h, the ROAD class (the lane's carriageway rows LN_ROAD0 68..LN_ROAD1 76 and the cross street's XS_R0..XS_R1) is 7.7% of the frame at luma sd/mean 0.065, against PATH.court 0.143, GRASS 0.131, SIDE.cross 0.185 and SIDE.quay 0.229 — three times flatter than the paving beside it, and it is the nearest big surface to the viewer. It is flat by construction, in two lines: groundBase's ROAD branch is the only ground colour whose hash term is HALVED (hv*0.5) over a pair six luma apart, and drawGround's ROAD branch strokes three joint lines and a course line at rgba(66,60,50,.14) with off=(y%2)*0.5, so the bond alternates by row and never runs, plus one 12%-alpha ellipse where hv>0.9. What a laid road has that this one does not: courses that RUN across a cell boundary (solve the bond off the cell AS DRAWN, the way slateGrid(y) solved the slate lattice at #125), a camber falling to the gutter the sweeper already works on row ~70, a kerb line, and REPAIR — paveWear[] has existed since #122 and on the roadway only drawPuddles' hollow term and trodStone's tint read it, so the cart's line and the crossing outside the tap should be visible on dry stone: worn setts, a patched square, tar in the joints. This is a bet: a 150-300 line diff is expected and welcome, and it is cache-time work on the existing dirty flag.
successLooksLike: On a dry day at 1600x950 the carriageway reads as laid stone with a bond you can follow across a cell boundary and a worn line where the cart runs; measured the same way, ROAD's sd/mean rises from 0.065 into the 0.13-0.20 band every other paved surface occupies without the class MEAN moving more than a few points; the cross street changes with it; and a same-code control run plus a canvas hash off the road show nothing outside the ROAD class moved.
avoid: Do not buy the contrast by darkening the roadway — a mean shift is not texture, and a foreground is graded on sd/mean, not absolute sd. Do not touch drawPuddles or the sweeper's own machinery, and do not add a tile kind. Do not put it in a LIVE pass: this is 1,500+ cells and belongs in the ground cache.
